ryan_ops: Quick FYI — Private/on-prem KMS + HSM integration is GA for v2.0 private deployments as of today. :tada:

ryan_ops: High-level callouts:
- Customers can now enable customer-managed keys (KMS) and integrate with FIPS-validated HSMs for key wrapping.
- Audit logs for key operations are captured and forwarded to the customer logging endpoint.
- We support AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and on-prem HSMs (PKCS#11).
- This is a config toggle in the private control plane; no app code changes required.

maya_devops: Nice. Is there a migration step for existing private clusters that currently use platform-managed keys?

ryan_ops: Good Q. Migration summary:
1) Enable CMK in the console or via the private API.
2) Provide KMS config and key ARN / PKCS#11 details.
3) We schedule a rolling rekey where the new CMK is used for all new secrets; old keys are retained for decrypt-only until TTL expires.
4) The process is automatic, but customers MUST confirm backup of existing key material if they manage HSMs.
Link: https://go.redwood.com/docs/private/kms-hsm-migration (internal)

sarah_legal: Compliance notes: SOC2 + ISO27001 covered. FedRAMP / HIPAA customers — HIPAA controls validated for key handling but FedRAMP high baseline still under assessment; legal will update this thread when complete. @ryan_ops please flag any customers that need FedRAMP for manual review.

ana_ceo: Huge win — nice work to infra + security. :lock: :tada:

eng-release: Packaging/release details:
- Private runtime image: redwood/private-runtime:v2.0.3
- Control-plane: redwood/private-control:v2026.03.23
- Release job kicked off at 1769505000, rollout to existing private installs begins 6h after approval window.

sre-bot: Deploy job queued: job_id=deploy-priv-kms-1769505000. Targets=private-clusters*. ETA ~4-8h.

maya_devops: Any SLA changes or maintenance windows we should publish to customers?

ryan_ops: No SLA change. We'll publish a short maintenance window for the rolling rekey (typically <10m per cluster). Customer-facing email template (draft) is here: https://go.redwood.com/internal/templates/kms-ga-email

sarah_legal: Also added an audit checklist for sales & support to confirm with customers before onboarding CMK/HSM: proof of key custody policy, contact for emergency key rotation, and contact for export/import procedures. Link: https://go.redwood.com/internal/checklists/kms-audit

eng-release: Post-deploy: please monitor tokenization errors and auth failures for the next 48h. Alert channel: #eng-oncall-private.

ryan_ops: If you see any telemetry spikes or decryption errors ping me + #eng-oncall-private. Will follow up with a short postmortem if anything anomalous occurs.

ana_ceo: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn from pilot to GA.

maya_devops: A few customers already asked about HSM attestation docs — sending them the SOC2 package + HSM vendor certs now.

ryan_ops: Closing: GA announced internally here. External blog + customer emails will follow this afternoon (marketing + sales looped in). Please escalate any unexpected issues to me directly.
